name: neo-pagan

attributes.attribute: honored as a deity by some present-day cults
claimed as one who follows the druid path
presides over farming and the crop season
worship may trace back to the Middle Ages
possible echo of an older god

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Neo-pagan names a god some followers of the old ways revere. Those who follow this cult claim to walk the druid path. The deity presides over farming and the seasons of the crops. Its worship appears to date from the Middle Ages. The figure may stand as a remnant of some older god.

okr.objective: Present the neo-pagan as a farming deity of the modern druid faith.
key_results: Modern cults of the old ways honor neo-pagan as a chief god.
Followers of the deity say they practice the druid path.
Its rôle spans farming and the growth of the harvest.
Writers place its worship in the Middle Ages and call it a trace of an older god.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
